utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good afternoon, this is Sberbank Kazakhstan. We're calling about a recent transaction on your account.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: What? I can't hear you. The connection is really bad. Sberbank, you said?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, Sberbank. We noticed a large purchase from an electronics store in Almaty. Was this your transaction?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, an electronics store? In Almaty? No, I'm in Astana. That's not me. What store?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: The transaction shows as 'Technodom, Almaty'. For 350,000 tenge. We just need to confirm your activity.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: 350,000 tenge? Definitely not mine. I'm driving right now. Can you block it?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: We've already placed a temporary hold on the funds. For your security, please be aware: we will NEVER ask you for your SMS code, card number, CVV, or PIN over the phone. Never share these with anyone. This call is just to verify the transaction. We can resolve this without any sensitive information from your side. We can send you a secure link to confirm non-recognition of the transaction.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Okay, a secure link sounds good. Yes, please send it. Thank you for checking.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: …for your appointment next Tuesday the fourth, at our Almaty branch. This is about your eGov services update, you requested it last month. Are you still able to make it?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: What? Sorry, the connection is terrible, I'm driving. Tuesday the fourth? Of what? Which branch? I can't hear you properly.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: THE FOURTH OF OCTOBER, sir, next Tuesday! For your eGov services. We are eGov support. We just need to confirm your attendance. Almaty branch, on Dostyk Avenue, number two hundred and seven. Two hundred and seven. Is that clear?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Dostyk two… I think I got it. Is this about my IIN update? I applied to update it because of some issues with Kaspi Bank payments. It wasn't processing correctly.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, precisely! That's why we're calling to confirm. We need to verify your identity in person for the update to go through. We will NOT ask for any SMS codes, card numbers, CVVs, or PINs over the phone. You should never share those with anyone. This is purely for in-person verification at the branch with your ID document.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Okay, that's reassuring, thank you. So, just my ID? No bank details, nothing like that needed?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Absolutely not. Only your national ID. We just need a yes or no regarding your attendance on the fourth. If you can't make it, we need to reschedule within two business days or your application will be closed, and you'll have to restart the whole process. Do you want me to cancel it?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: No, no, don't cancel it! I'll be there. The fourth. Dostyk two hundred and seven. I think I can make it. I need this IIN fixed for my Kaspi issues.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Excellent! Your appointment is confirmed for Tuesday, October fourth, at 10 AM, Almaty branch, Dostyk two hundred and seven. Please bring your national ID. We look forward to assisting you.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Right, 10 AM. Got it. Thanks for the call. And the clarification.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: You're welcome. Have a good day, sir.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: You too. Bye.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Hello? Max, is that you? You said you'd call back.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Aman, my dear Aman, it's not Max, it's Zhanna from Magnum. Your parcel is here, but you put the wrong address for your new flat. You're still putting the old one in e-shop orders, my little forgetful one!

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Zhanna? Magnum? What? I can't hear you, the connection's terrible, I'm driving. What parcel? I didn't order anything recently from Magnum direct.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Your vitamins and that special coffee, from the one that starts with an 'E', you know. The one you bought on Monday. It came through our delivery system. Look, you just need to confirm your IIN so we can re-route it to your correct address in Almaty. Just the IIN, nothing else sensitive, don't worry. We'd never ask for your card number, CVV, or any SMS codes. That's for scammers, not for us!

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Vitamins? Coffee? Oh, the stuff from EcoLife? But I put my new address there, I'm sure I did. And my IIN? Over the phone? Isn't that… you know, usually you don't ask for that.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Well, usually you don't put the wrong address, eh? Just kidding, Aman, relax. It's just to confirm your identity so we can update the delivery information in our system directly. It's standard procedure for address corrections. We don't need your PIN or password, or for you to install anything, just your IIN to match against our records. If you're really uncomfortable, you can come to our main warehouse office with your ID, but it will delay delivery by a day or two.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Delay? Ugh. My wife needs those vitamins. I'm still driving, the signal is really bad. Can you spell out your name and the company name, just to be sure? I'm paranoid with all these scams going around.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Zhanna, darling, Z-H-A-N-N-A. And Magnum Logistics. Don't worry, we're not asking you to move money or give us any bank details. Remember, a real bank or service will NEVER ask for your SMS code, card number, or login details over the phone. Anyone who does is a fraudster. We just need your IIN to verify you're you, so the package goes to the right Aman, not some other Aman with a similar name, you know? Just the numbers, please, so we can get this sorted for your new place in Auezov District.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Okay, okay, fine. Let me just… pull over a second. It's… 860312...

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello, Zhasik? Can you hear me? The line is terrible.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, hi! Barely. Kids are screaming here. Who is this?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: It's Aibol, from Astana Bank. Remember that big transfer to Shymkent yesterday? The one for your uncle's dacha project, ha ha.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Ah, Aibol! Yes, I do. Everything okay with it? What's up?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: All good, just confirming it went through smoothly. Also, a quick heads-up: we will never ask you for any SMS codes, card numbers, or your password on the phone, okay? Just so you know, always be careful. If anyone ever asks, it's a scam.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Got it, Aibol. Thanks for the reminder. No, you guys never do. That's why I like you.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Exactly! Anyway, wanted to confirm. Your uncle got the tenge, all fine. Have a great day, Zhasik!

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: You too! Rahmet!

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good morning. This is the National Bank of Kazakhstan, financial monitoring department, calling to confirm a recent transaction on your Kaspi Gold account. Your case reference number is NBFM-7734-9821. Are you Ms. Dinara Abisheva?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Who is this? What Kaspi transaction? I didn't authorize anyone to call me about my bank account.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: This is a standard verification call regarding a transfer of 85,000 tenge initiated yesterday, May 15th, at approximately 3:45 PM, to a vendor listed as 'TechSolutions LLP' in Shymkent. We just need to confirm your awareness of this transaction to ensure it's not fraudulent. We're not asking for any personal details, just verbal confirmation.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Wait, Shymkent? TechSolutions? I don't remember any... wait, no, I did buy that new laptop! From their online store. Okay, yes, that was me. Why are you calling, though?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Thank you for the confirmation, Ms. Abisheva. We initiated this call because the transaction amount exceeded your usual spending pattern for online purchases with that vendor. Your confirmation resolves the flag. We will now close case NBFM-7734-9821. Have a good day.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good afternoon, this is Arman from ForteBank's fraud prevention department. Am I speaking with Mr. Alibek Nurzhanov?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Yes, that's me. How can I help you, Arman?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Mr. Nurzhanov, we're calling to confirm a recent transaction on your ForteBank account ending in eight-four-three-nine. There was an attempt to make a payment of ninety-five thousand tenge to an online electronics retailer, TechZone, approximately fifteen minutes ago.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, ninety-five thousand? TechZone? I didn't make any such purchase.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Thank you for confirming, Mr. Nurzhanov. We suspected this might be the case. To clarify, the amount was nine-five, zero-zero-zero tenge.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Nine-five thousand, yes, I heard that. Definitely not me. Is my account safe?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Your account security is our top priority, Mr. Nurzhanov. We have already temporarily blocked the transaction attempt. For your protection, we will also place a temporary hold on further online transactions for the next twenty-four hours to allow us to review the activity. This is a standard security measure.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: A temporary hold? So I won't be able to buy anything online today?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: That is correct, Mr. Nurzhanov, only for online purchases. All other card functions, such as ATM withdrawals and point-of-sale transactions, will remain fully operational. We will send you an SMS confirmation shortly regarding the temporary hold and its duration. There is no further action required from your side.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Okay, that sounds fine. I appreciate you catching that. So, I don't need to do anything?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Precisely, Mr. Nurzhanov. Our security team will handle the investigation. We will contact you again if any further information is needed, but for now, you are all set. Thank you for your cooperation.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Alright, thank you for calling and for sorting this out, Arman. Have a good day.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: You as well, Mr. Nurzhanov. Goodbye.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Hello? Ayaz, is that you?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good afternoon. This is Saltanat from your sister's office. She asked me to contact you.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Saltanat? Which office? What's this about?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Your sister, Dinara, had an urgent payment come up. She needs to send money to her supplier. The Kaspi limit is reached.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Dinara? Why isn't she calling me herself? This sounds a bit off.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: She's in a meeting with the supplier in Almaty. Time-sensitive. She asked if you could make a quick transfer of 75,000 tenge to her Halyk account.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: 75,000 tenge to Halyk? And you're sure this is for Dinara? Not some new 'Kaspi security issue'?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, absolutely for Dinara. I can confirm her IIN if you like. She will call you right after her meeting. Just the transfer to her Halyk account ending in 8901.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Hello? Baurzhan, is that you? The kids are making such a racket.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good afternoon, this is Arman from the Almaty City Social Support Department. I'm calling to confirm your annual social assistance payment for families with multiple children. Is this Aigul Serikkyzy Omarova?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, uh, no, it's Aigul Askarqyzy. And actually, I was expecting a call from the kindergarten... What was that about a payment?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Aigul Askarqyzy. My apologies. The IIN I have ends in 8754. Could you confirm that? We need to verify your identity to proceed with the payment transfer.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: 8754? Hold on, let me check. Kids, quiet down for a second! My IIN is... yes, it ends in 8754. What payment is this exactly? I didn't apply for anything recently.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: This is the automatic annual payment for families with four or more children, initiated by the Presidential Decree. It was processed on the 10th of this month. We just need to confirm your Kaspi Bank account for the transfer. You have an account with us, correct?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: An automatic payment? On the 10th? I haven't seen anything in my Kaspi. Are you sure? What was that department again? It's really loud here, I can barely hear you.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Almaty City Social Support Department, ma'am! The funds were allocated. We need to confirm the last four digits of your Kaspi account to ensure it's transferred to the correct recipient. Is it 1234, as per our records?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: 1234? My Kaspi card ends in, uh, 5678. Not 1234. That's definitely wrong. Maybe it's a different payment?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: No, it is the same payment. We will update the system. Can you verify your full Kaspi account number just for confirmation? No, no, wait, I see a note here. The 1234 was an old account. Let me confirm the new one. Is your primary account the one ending in 5678?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Yes, that's my main one, 5678. My goodness, this is a surprise. How much is it?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: The amount is 120,000 tenge. It will be disbursed into your confirmed account within the next 24 hours. Just to be absolutely clear, you confirm that your primary Kaspi account ends in 5678, not 1234, correct?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Yes, 5678. Okay, wow. That's unexpected, but good! Thank you, I think... So it'll just appear?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, it will appear. There's no further action required from your side. We just needed to reconcile the account details. Have a good day, Aigul Askarqyzy.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: You too. Bye. Kids, stop fighting over that toy!

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: ...and so for your package from Almaty, it shows here as ready for pickup. Your IIN ends in four zero three eight?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Wait, what package? And who is this? You're calling about a package from Almaty? I didn't order anything from Almaty.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: This is Exline courier service, regarding tracking number KZ558912. It's a small parcel. Look, I just need to confirm your identity to release it.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Exline? Are you sure? I usually use Post Express. This sounds... suspicious. Is this about that thing my aunt sent maybe?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Sir, I have a queue. If you are not user Balasagyn, then I will mark it for return to sender. Just confirm the IIN, please. Or tell me your full name to check.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello? Can you hear me? The line is very bad.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Yes, I can hear you now. What's up? (Sounds of children playing in the background).

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: This is Bekzat from ForteBank. We're calling about a recent transaction on your account, IIN ending in five-three-one-one. There was a large transfer to an account in Almaty.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: ForteBank? A transfer? Which IIN ending? Five-three-one-what? I'm a bit busy right now. (A child's voice: "Mommy, look!")

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Five-three-one-one! One! Look, it's urgent. We need to verify this transfer, it was for two million tenge, just this morning. Are you aware of this transaction?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good afternoon, this is Arman Alimov calling from the National Pension Fund of Kazakhstan, reference case number two zero two three dash five six seven eight nine. We are calling regarding a discrepancy identified in your recent pension contributions for the month of September. This is a notification of a system update that requires your confirmation of personal details to avoid any future delays in your payout. Please confirm your identity.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: The National Pension Fund? Who exactly is this? I haven't received anything about any discrepancies. What kind of details are you asking for?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: As I said, Arman Alimov. We require verification of your IIN and the last four digits of your registered Kaspi Bank account for confirmation purposes only. I repeat, two zero two three dash five six seven eight nine. This is a standard procedure following an automated audit. And let me make this absolutely clear for your security, we will NEVER ask you for your full card number, the CVV, your PIN, or any SMS or OTP codes. You should never share those with anyone, even if they claim to be from us. No sensitive financial information or codes are needed to resolve this system update; anything truly sensitive is handled only in person at one of our branches with your ID document. Do you understand?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Okay, IIN... you said two zero two three, what was the rest of that case number? And which Kaspi account? I have a few.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: The case number is two zero two three DASH five six seven eight nine. FIVE SIX SEVEN EIGHT NINE. And it's the account linked to your pension contributions. We just need the last four digits. This is a simple confirmation, not a request for sensitive data.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Alright, let me just check. It's... one two three four. And my IIN is...

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello? Can you hear me?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Yes, barely. Who is this? Kids, quiet down!

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: This is Pavel from Globus Express! Regarding your delivery for the IIN ending 8812! It's about your payment failure for the import fees. We need to confirm details, fast!

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Payment failure? But I paid with my Halyk card... What details? Wait, I didn't get any notification.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: The system shows it bounced. We need to verify it's you! Look, we will NEVER ask for your SMS code, card number, CVV, or PIN over the phone. Never share that with anyone! We just need to confirm your name and the tracking number to manually process it, so your parcel from Almaty isn't returned!

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Hello? Bakhyt? Is that you, Bakhyt?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good morning. This is Kaspi Bank. My name is Elmira. I'm calling about a recent transaction on your account. We just need to verify it. Don't worry, we won't ask for any codes or card numbers.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Kaspi Bank? What? I can't hear you. A transaction? Is there a problem?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: No problem at all, ma'am. Just a quick verification. We saw a payment of fifty thousand tenge. To a new online vendor. For electronics. Does that sound right?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Fifty thousand... Yes, yes! My grandson bought a tablet. For school. Is everything okay with it?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Perfectly fine, ma'am. We just needed to confirm. We will never ask for your SMS codes, your card number, or your password over the phone. Never share those with anyone. This call is just for confirmation. Thank you for your time. Have a good day.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, okay. Thank you, dear. You too.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: …hello? Sorry, kids are a bit wild today.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Ah, Gulnarochka! Just the person. It's Aidana from Turkistan Utilities. Remember that water leak claim from last month?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, right! The one in the building basement. Did they finally fix it?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Fixed and approved! The compensation for the disruption is ready. We just need to confirm your Kaspi Gold account for the transfer. You're still on IIN ending 1234, correct?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: My IIN? (Kids screaming louder) Oh, probably, yes. But Kaspi Gold? How do I confirm it now?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Easy, no worries. We absolutely don't need any SMS codes, card numbers, or your password, Gulnarochka. Never share those with anyone, even us. We just need to verify your full name and the last four digits of the Kaspi account on file with your IIN. It’s just to make sure it's really you before we send money.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Right, okay. So, no codes, no card details… just what's already on file? And my full name?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Exactly! We'd never ask for anything sensitive over the phone. For anything like that, you'd come to our office with your ID. So, can you give me your full name as on your ID, and then just confirm the last four of your Kaspi, if you have it handy?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Okay, one sec. (Muffled voice, sounds of searching) Alright, it’s Gulnar Adilbekkyzy Baimuratova. And the Kaspi… let me check the app quickly… (sound of app opening) …it’s 5678.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Perfect, Gulnarochka! That matches what we have here. The transfer will go out by end of day today, expect it in your Kaspi Gold tomorrow. Anything else I can help with?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: No, that’s great, thank you! Finally done with that. Have a good one, Aidana!

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: You too, enjoy the peace and quiet after those little ones! Bye!

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: ...hello? Hello, I can barely hear you, who is this?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, hello, this is Gulnar from ForteBank, regarding your recent transaction, if you could just confirm your identity, please?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: ForteBank? Gulnar? Which transaction are you talking about? I just paid my utilities this morning, was that it?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: No, no, not the utilities. We're calling about a transfer, a rather large amount, to a new recipient. We need to verify it wasn't... a mistake, or unauthori... authorized, I mean. It's to a Mr. Bakytzhan Serikov in Almaty. Do you recognise that name?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Bakytzhan Serikov? Almaty? Hmm, I don't think so. My grandson is in Almaty, but his name is Arman. Are you sure you have the right person? What's my IIN?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Ma'am, I can't provide your IIN for security. I just need you to confirm if you sent 500,000 tenge to Bakytzhan Serikov today. It shows from your account ending in ... four three eight one.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: 500,000 tenge! That's a huge sum! No, I absolutely did not send that! Are you sure it's my account? What account number did you say? My card ends... oh, four three eight one, yes, that's my card. But I didn't send anything like that!

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Right, so you did not authorise this transfer to Bakytzhan Serikov. Good, that's what we needed to confirm. We'll block the transaction immediately and investigate further from our side. No need for you to do anything. Just be aware it was attempted.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Block it? Oh, thank goodness. I was getting worried. So, it wasn't successful? My money is safe then? Thank you, Gulnar. So, no need to go to the bank?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: No, ma'am, your money is safe. No need to come in. We've initiated the block. You may get an SMS notification about the block soon. Just confirming that was not you. Okay, goodbye then.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello? Can you hear me? This is… Almaty Finance… or sorry, Astana Finance. Is that Mr. Bolatbek?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Hello? Yes, I can hear you, just barely. Who is this? And no, it's Ms. Bolatbek. Bolatbekova. Hold on, kids, stop that! What did you say about Astana Finance?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, Astana Finance. We're calling about a recent transaction on your… your current account. A large sum to a… a construction company, Asem-Kurys. Did you authorize this, Ms. Bolatbekova?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Asem-Kurys? What? No, I don't recall… Wait. Oh, my goodness, yes! The payment for the kitchen renovation! I completely forgot! Is everything alright with it? Did it go through?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: That's what we're confirming, yes. We just wanted to make sure it wasn't some kind of… fraud. Given the amount. Your IIN ends in four-five-seven-one, correct?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Yes, that's right. Four-five-seven-one. Fraud? Is there an issue? Kids, stop pulling that! Are you saying the money didn't go to Asem-Kurys?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: No, no, it's just a routine verification for high-value trans… transactions. It's pending approval on our side, but we needed your verbal confirmation. Just to, you know, protect your funds. We saw you, uh, haven't made such a large payment to them before.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, okay. So it's fine then? You just needed me to say it's real? Yes, it's definitely real. My kitchen is almost finished, thank goodness. My husband will be home soon. What time is it?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, exactly. So we'll proceed with the… the final processing of the payment. No further action needed from your end. Expect to see it fully processed within the next hour or so. Thank you for your time, Ms. Bolatbekova.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Alright, thank you for checking! I appreciate it. Goodbye.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good afternoon, this is Ardak from the Aktobe branch of Kazpost, case number KP-9-4-7-0-5. I am calling to confirm a recent transaction. Can I speak to Ms. Aigul Kerimova?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: (children's voices in background) Ardak? Uh, yes, this is Aigul. What transaction? Is everything alright?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Ms. Kerimova, there's an outgoing transfer of 150,000 tenge to an account we've flagged for unusual activity. We need you to confirm if this transfer to IIN 870123... (cuts off)

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello, hello? Can you hear me, Ayazhan?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Who is this? The line is very bad. I cannot hear you clearly, who is speaking?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: It's me, Arman! From the Almaty Social Security office. Remember, your pension update? We spoke last week, baba.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Arman? Ah, Arman! But why are you calling so early? I thought it was next week. And what pension update? My pension is always on time, no problems.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, yes, your pension is fine, don't worry! This is just a quick check for the new benefit calculation system. You know how eGov sometimes has these glitches, right? We just need to confirm your IIN and then you'll get a small bonus, a one-time payment for the transition.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Bonus? What bonus? No one told me about any bonus. And my IIN, you already have my IIN! I gave it to you when I visited the office, remember? What's going on?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, Ayazhan, we do have it! But this is just a verbal confirmation required by the system, just to make sure it's really you. It's a new regulation, very simple. Don't worry, it's nothing complicated, just for the system to register your consent for the new calculation. And that bonus will be directly deposited to your Kaspi Gold, a nice 15,000 tenge for your troubles.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: 15,000 tenge? For what? This sounds... I don't know, Arman. Are you sure this is legitimate? What if someone is trying to... I read in the news about these calls...

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Ayazhan, my dear, it's me! Arman! We've known each other for years, haven't we? I wouldn't mess with you. This is from the department, perfectly legitimate. It's just a small token from the government to smooth over the transition. You don't have to do anything, just say 'yes' to confirm your IIN and we process it. You'll see the money in your account by end of day, promise. Just say your IIN for me, please.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: My IIN... you want me to say it now? Over the phone? But...

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, baba, just for the audio record, that's all. Quick and easy, then you can go back to your morning coffee. Come on, Ayazhan, don't make me fill out extra paperwork because you're suspicious! Just your IIN, please. For old times' sake!

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, fine, fine, Arman. Alright. It's [callee's IIN]. Are you sure about this bonus, though?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Absolutely sure, Ayazhan! You'll see. Thanks a million, you made my job easier today. Have a wonderful day!

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Alright. You too, Arman. If it's really 15,000 tenge, I'll believe you.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Hello? Yes? Who is this?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good afternoon, this is Erlan from AstanaPost, regarding your parcel. Can you hear me clearly? We have a delivery scheduled for you today.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Astana... who? I didn't quite catch that. My hearing isn't what it used to be. Is it about that package from my nephew?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: ASTANA-POST! Yes, your parcel from Almaty! It's been flagged for urgent delivery. We need to confirm your IIN for release. It's a standard procedure for high-value items, you understand?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: My IIN? Oh, but I gave that already when I ordered... Wait, I think my cat just knocked over a vase, one moment. *clattering sounds* Right, sorry. What was that again about the IIN?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Your IIN, madam! It's for verification, to ensure the parcel goes to the correct recipient. Look, we have a lot of deliveries today, so if you could just quickly confirm it, we can get this moving. Otherwise, it might be delayed until tomorrow!

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Delayed? Oh dear. My IIN is... is it still on the card? I'm looking for my Kaspi Gold card now. Do you need the full number?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: No, just the IIN, madam, not your card details! Just the eleven digits. We just need to cross-reference it with our system to release the package for immediate delivery.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello, is this... uh... Aigul Nurbekova? My name is Askhat from Shymkentgaz. We're calling about your recent service order, uh, number, wait, one, four, six, oh, three, three, eight, nine, uh, seven. You submitted it last week, yes?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: (Sounds of children in background) Shymkentgaz? Oh, um, hi. Nurbekova, yes, that's me. What about the order? Kids, quiet please!

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, so, the order for the gas meter check, uh, number one four six zero three three eight nine seven. Did you catch that? One, four, six, zero, three, three, eight, nine, seven. We need to confirm the best time for our technician to visit your apartment on Abay street. Our system, it's showing... uh... an open slot for tomorrow, between nine and twelve.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Tomorrow? No, no, tomorrow is impossible. I have a school meeting for my son. Wait, which number did you say? One four six zero... seven? Kids, I said quiet!

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: One four six zero three three eight nine seven. The, uh, last four digits are three eight nine seven. So, tomorrow is no good. What about Thursday? We have an opening, uh, around... four PM to six PM. It's a quick, quick check, maybe twenty, thirty minutes.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Thursday... (distant shouting) Thursday might work, but not too late. The kids' bedtime. So, it's just a check? No payment or anything needed, right? Because I saw something about a payment for...

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: No, no, Aigul Nurbekova, this is just to confirm the appointment for the check. The standard, uh, verification. Any payments would be handled directly through Kaspi or Halyk, as usual, after the service. This is only to schedule the visit. So, Thursday, four to six PM, is good then?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Hmm. Okay, I suppose that works. Thursday, four to six. Just make sure the technician calls me an hour before, okay? So I can, you know, prepare.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, yes, of course. Our technician will call you one hour before arrival, uh, on your registered number. That's eight, uh, seven, double oh, uh, five, five, five, zero, seven, zero, seven? Just to double check.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Yes, that's my number. And please, just, no later than six. It's a busy household here.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Understood, Aigul Nurbekova. Thursday, four to six PM. Technician will call. Thank you for your time. Have a good day. (Muttering) And the next one is...

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: You too. Bye. (Sighs, then, to children) What did I tell you about fighting over the toy car?!

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good afternoon, this is Global Express Courier Service, Astana Branch. My name is Alexey Smirnov, case number GE-789012. We have an urgent package for you, Mr. Baykadamov. It's a re-delivery attempt from your Kaspi Bank, containing a new debit card. We attempted delivery yesterday, but you weren't home. This is our final attempt today between 3 and 5 PM. To confirm your address and ensure delivery, can you confirm your IIN and current address?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Who is this? Kaspi Bank? I didn't order a new card. What is IIN? Speak slowly, please.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Mr. Baykadamov, I am from Global Express, the courier service. We are delivering for Kaspi Bank. Your Individual Identification Number, IIN. We require it to verify your identity for secure delivery. And please, I need you to listen carefully. I want to reassure you that as a legitimate courier service, and on behalf of Kaspi Bank, we will NEVER ask you for your SMS code, your card number, CVV, or PIN. You should never share those with anyone. This is purely for identity verification for delivery. Can you confirm your address: Abay Street 45, Apartment 12?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Abay Street... yes, that's it. But what about this IIN? I don't give out my IIN over the phone. Is this... is this safe?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Mr. Baykadamov, your IIN is standard for identity confirmation for official deliveries in Kazakhstan! It's not sensitive like a PIN! This package is time-sensitive, it contains your new bank card. If we cannot confirm your identity and address now, we will return it to Kaspi Bank, and you will have to go to the branch in person. We don't ask for any sensitive financial information, only your IIN and address to make sure it's you! Now, can you confirm your IIN so we can proceed, or should I mark it as undeliverable?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Good afternoon, this is Nurzhan from Jusan Bank security department. Am I speaking with Mr. Alibek Smagulov?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Nurzhan? What? I can't hear you, connection's really bad... Smagulov? Yes, that's me. What's this about?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Smagulov. We're calling to confirm a recent transaction initiated from your account ending in 7890. It was a transfer of 150,000 tenge to an account at ForteBank, just a few minutes ago. For your security, please be aware that we will never ask for your SMS code, card number, CVV, or password over the phone. We only need your verbal confirmation.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: 150,000? Oh, yes, that was me! Just sent it to my brother. Glad you called though, I always worry about these things. So, no codes, right? What was that about codes?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: That's correct, Mr. Smagulov. We never require any sensitive information like codes, card details, or passwords for verification in such cases. If anyone ever requests those details claiming to be from the bank, please disconnect immediately. This call is purely for confirmation, no further action is required from your side.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: ...confirming your appointment with Dr. Adil Khan at the Astana Polyclinic No. 7. We show it's scheduled for this coming Tuesday, November 14th, at 10:30 AM for your annual check-up.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: What? Sorry, the connection is really bad. I'm driving... can you repeat that? Astana Polyclinic? I can barely hear you.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, Polyclinic Number Seven, Dr. Adil Khan, Tuesday, November fourteenth, at ten-thirty AM. Is that correct for your routine physical examination?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, that's right! I totally forgot. Thanks for the reminder. Hold on a second, this traffic light is forever. My daughter just started school nearby, so I'm always around that area now. Anyway, so, you're just confirming it?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Yes, exactly. We're just confirming. And please remember, a representative from the polyclinic will never ask you for any sensitive information like your Kaspi card number, CVV, PIN, or any SMS codes over the phone. All identity verification or confidential data handling is done in person at the clinic with your IIN and an ID document. We just need a simple confirmation now.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Okay, good to know. Yeah, I've had some weird calls lately. But yes, that appointment works for me. Confirmed.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Excellent. We look forward to seeing you then. Have a good day.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Hello? Can you hear me, ma'am? The line is a bit crackly.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Yes, I can hear you. Who is this? You're a bit faint.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: This is... uh... Kuryer Express, ma'am. We have a delivery for you from the... uh... Pavlodar branch of ForteBank. It's a new bank card. We tried to deliver it to your address on record, but the building was closed. We need to confirm a new time. Are you Mrs. Serikova, by any chance?

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Serikova? No, my name is Petrova. And I don't recall ordering a card from Pavlodar. I'm in Astana. Are you sure you have the right number? My granddaughter just got a new kitten, it's very playful, jumps all over the place.

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Ah, Petrova, my apologies! My screen is a bit... My mistake. Yes, Mrs. Petrova. It's not a new card, my apologies again. It's a replacement card, the one for your... for your pension, I think? From ForteBank. The system says it's a replacement. We just need to schedule redelivery. And please, ma'am, just for your safety, we will NEVER ask you for any SMS codes, your card number, CVV, or your IIN over the phone. We only confirm delivery details. Do not share such information with anyone, even if they claim to be from the bank or courier service.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Oh, a replacement card? Yes, that makes sense now. My old one expires next month. What time were you thinking?

utterances.speaker: caller
utterances.text: Can we try tomorrow between 2 PM and 5 PM? We'll come to your registered address. Just confirm that works, and please be ready with your ID. No codes or other information needed from you at the door, just your signature and ID check. We just need to ensure it's you.

utterances.speaker: callee
utterances.text: Tomorrow, two to five? Yes, that should be fine. I'll be home. My ID is ready. Thank you.
